julie-cust: Hey @emma-cs — after rotating our SSO key this morning, embeddings calls are failing with 403. Quick curl:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-XXXX" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"test"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
```
Response: 403 {"error":"insufficient_scope","message":"missing required scope: embeddings"}

emma-cs: Sorry to hear that — can you paste the rotation id or svcacct id? Did you use the SSO provisioner CSV flow or the console?

julie-cust: rotation id 2026-03-16T08:12Z, svcacct: team-ml-ci. We used the CSV upload. Can repro on our dev box with same key.

devin-eng: @emma-cs @julie-cust that error string normally means the token "scopes" claim doesn't include embeddings. Can you paste the token payload (redact sig)?

julie-cust: payload (redacted): {"sub":"team-ml-ci", "scopes":"infer,generation"} — looks like embeddings dropped.

provisioner-bot: Provisioner run 2026-03-16T08:11:59Z parsed CSV line: "team-ml-ci, infer,generation,embeddings" — parser detected 4 fields; trailing whitespace handling: FAILURE (last token trimmed).

devin-eng: Ok root cause: CSV row had extra spacing/CRLF and our simple split trimmed the last scope. Patch incoming. Quick remediation: reprovision the svcacct or reissue a key with explicit scopes.

emma-cs: Remediation steps for customer (short):
1) Console: Teams -> team-ml-ci -> Edit scopes -> ensure embeddings checked -> Save.
2) CLI: `redwoodctl provision update --svcacct team-ml-ci --scopes "infer,generation,embeddings"`
3) If they rotated keys already, either rotate again or create a new key: `redwoodctl keys create --svcacct team-ml-ci --scopes "infer,generation,embeddings"`
Expected result: token payload should include "scopes": "infer,generation,embeddings" and embeddings calls return 200.

julie-cust: Running step 2 now.

julie-cust: Update — reprovisioned and created a new key, embeddings calls now return 200 and vectors are generated. Thanks! :tada:

devin-eng: I'll push a fix to the provisioner parser (trim/quote handling) and add a migration that checks svcaccts created in the last 24h for missing scopes. Filed INF-2389.

emma-cs: Great — marking this thread resolved on our side. Thanks for the quick repro and confirmation, @julie-cust :white_check_mark:
